title: Teachers Use Games for More Enjoyable Learning
titleZh: 教师利用游戏带来更愉快的学习体验
credits: Jill Robbins wrote this lesson for Learning English.

sentences.en: Wordle has become one of the most popular online games in the United States since it came out last October.
sentences.zh: Wordle自去年10月推出以来，已成为美国最受欢迎的在线游戏之一。

sentences.en: Players get six chances to guess and learn a five-letter word for the day.
sentences.zh: 玩家有六次机会来猜测并学习当天的一个五字母单词。

sentences.en: Many are sharing their game results on social media, adding more interest in the game.
sentences.zh: 许多人正在社交媒体上分享他们的游戏成绩，进一步增加了对这款游戏的兴趣。

sentences.en: Creative teachers have long found games could make their classes more enjoyable for students.
sentences.zh: 富有创意的老师早就发现，游戏可以让学生们的课堂更加有趣。

sentences.en: During the pandemic, many have looked for new ways or games to help their students learn.
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，许多人都在寻找新的方法或游戏来帮助学生们的学习。

sentences.en: It is part of a learning theory called “gamification” to keep students’ interest.
sentences.zh: 这是名为“游戏化”的一种学习理论的一部分，用来保持学生的兴趣。

sentences.en: Beyond Wordle, here are other games that help learners with different subjects.
sentences.zh: 除了Wordle，以下是其他帮助学习者学习不同科目的游戏。

sentences.en: British data scientist Richard Mann of London was talking with his daughter about the popularity of Wordle.
sentences.zh: 伦敦的英国数据科学家理查德·曼在与女儿谈论Wordle的流行时，

sentences.en: He thought there should be a game for people who like mathematics and developed Nerdle.
sentences.zh: 他认为应该有一款为喜欢数学的人准备的游戏，于是开发了Nerdle。

sentences.en: It is a daily game in which a player has six tries to guess a math solution.
sentences.zh: 这是一款每日游戏，玩家有六次机会来猜测一个数学解答。

sentences.en: Does it sound familiar?
sentences.zh: 听起来是不是很熟悉？

sentences.en: Math teachers note that a Nerdle player uses logic, a careful way of thinking about something, to solve a math problem.
sentences.zh: 数学老师指出，Nerdle的玩家运用逻辑——一种对某事进行仔细思考的方式——来解决数学问题。

sentences.en: It is similar to how a Wordle player applies logic to guess a word.
sentences.zh: 这与Wordle的玩家运用逻辑来猜测单词的方式类似。

sentences.en: Do not confuse Wordle with Worldle.
sentences.zh: 不要把Wordle和Worldle混淆。

sentences.en: There is an extra letter ‘l” in Worldle.
sentences.zh: Worldle里多了一个字母“l”。

sentences.en: French video game developer Antoine Teuf said he invented Worldle in honor of that word game, Wordle.
sentences.zh: 法国电子游戏开发者安托万·特夫说他发明Worldle是为了纪念这款文字游戏Wordle。

sentences.en: Players guess a country based on its shape.
sentences.zh: 玩家根据国家的形状来猜测国家。

sentences.en: They get six tries to guess a country based on information about the country.
sentences.zh: 他们有六次机会，根据关于该国家的信息来猜测国家。

sentences.en: Teuf first shared the game on January 22.
sentences.zh: 特夫首次于1月22日分享了这款游戏。

sentences.en: He said there are two million visits a day to the game’s page a month later.
sentences.zh: 他说，一个月后，这款游戏页面每天有两百万次访问。

sentences.en: Teachers of English see word games as a way for students to learn new words.
sentences.zh: 英语教师把单词游戏看作是学生学习新单词的一种方式。

sentences.en: Other word games include Blooket and Flippity.
sentences.zh: 其他单词游戏包括Blooket和Flippity。

sentences.en: Teachers create quizzes in Blooket similar to the kinds of games students play on mobile devices.
sentences.zh: 教师在Blooket上创建测验，其形式类似于学生在移动设备上玩的游戏。

sentences.en: They can look at results and see areas that students can improve.
sentences.zh: 他们可以查看结果，看到学生可以改进的地方。

sentences.en: In Flippity, teachers can create flash cards, rewards, spelling quizzes, memory games and word searches from a simple Google spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 在Flippity中，教师可以通过一个简单的谷歌表格创建抽认卡、奖励、拼写测验、记忆游戏和单词搜索。

sentences.en: It is also a good tool for students to create their own projects.
sentences.zh: 它也是学生创建自己项目的好工具。

sentences.en: There are several online services that teachers could use to “gamify” learning.
sentences.zh: 有几种在线服务是教师可以用来将学习“游戏化”的。

sentences.en: They include Kahoot!, Quizlet, Quizziz and Nearpod.
sentences.zh: 它们包括Kahoot!、Quizlet、Quizziz和Nearpod。

sentences.en: All of them “gamify” learning by creating competition among learners while reviewing the content presented by teachers.
sentences.zh: 它们都通过在复习教师所展示内容的过程中营造学习者之间的竞争来将学习“游戏化”。

sentences.en: In many places, teachers and students do not have a computer.
sentences.zh: 在许多地方，教师和学生都没有电脑。

sentences.en: So, English language teacher Larry Ferlazzo asked them to share their language-learning games.
sentences.zh: 因此，英语语言教师拉里·费尔拉佐请他们分享各自的语言学习游戏。

sentences.en: Ferlazzo wrote about them in his blog.
sentences.zh: 费尔拉佐在他的博客里写了这些游戏。

sentences.en: Here are two of the games that teachers suggested:
sentences.zh: 以下是教师们建议的两种游戏：

sentences.en: Danielle Horne teaches at Helena College in Glen Forrest, Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 丹妮尔·霍恩在澳大利亚西部格伦福雷斯特的海伦纳学院任教。

sentences.en: She said one of the games that her students love playing is “hot or cold.”
sentences.zh: 她说，她的学生喜欢玩的游戏之一是“忽冷忽热”。

sentences.en: In “hot or cold,” students hide something in the classroom while a student, or searcher, is waiting outside.
sentences.zh: 在“忽冷忽热”游戏中，当一名学生（即搜寻者）在外面等候时，其他学生会把某样东西藏在教室里。

sentences.en: The students then say a word, phrase, or sentence.
sentences.zh: 然后，学生们会说出一个单词、短语或句子。

sentences.en: They get louder when the searcher gets nearer to the object and softer when the searcher is more distant.
sentences.zh: 当搜寻者靠近该物品时声音会变大，当搜寻者离得更远时声音会变小。

sentences.en: Horne said to be prepared for quite a bit of noise though!
sentences.zh: 霍恩说，不过要做好噪音相当大的准备哦！

sentences.en: Eva Pors is a Danish high school teacher.
sentences.zh: 伊娃·珀尔斯是一名丹麦的高中教师。

sentences.en: Her students play “questions and answers” to learn new words or vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 她的学生通过"问答"游戏来学习新单词或词汇。

sentences.en: Pors write words or phrases on small pieces of paper and divides students into groups of four.
sentences.zh: 波斯把单词或短语写在小纸片上，并将学生分成四人一组。

sentences.en: Within a group, student A picks a piece of paper with a word or phrase on it and asks questions that will make student B say the exact word or phrase on the paper.
sentences.zh: 在小组内，学生A抽取一张写有单词或短语的纸片，并提出问题，使学生B说出纸片上的确切单词或短语。

sentences.en: For example, with the word “milk,” Student A would ask, “What do you put on your cereal in the morning?”
sentences.zh: 例如，对于单词"牛奶"，学生A会问："早上你往麦片里加什么?"

sentences.en: Student B has one minute to try to answer as many words or phrases as possible.
sentences.zh: 学生B有一分钟的时间，尽量回答出尽可能多的单词或短语。

sentences.en: The other two students in the group will then take over for one minute.
sentences.zh: 然后小组里的另外两名学生各接管一分钟。

sentences.en: And the team with the most correct guesses wins the game.
sentences.zh: 猜对最多的小组赢得游戏。

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。

glossary.def: to give an answer or opinion about something without having all the facts
the practice of making activities more like games in order to make them more interesting or enjoyable:
something given in exchange for good behavior or good work
a game or competition in which you answer questions
a computer program that helps make calculations and store information
a food that is made from grain and eaten with milk, especially in the morning
